recipes.decision_question: Does the fitted relationship generalize, and where do residual or influence structures fail?
admissible_claims: predictive fit on the named evaluation split
scoped residual pattern
identified influential observations
preconditions: residual definition matches the model family
evaluation data were not used for model or threshold selection
minimum_views: observed versus fitted with identity line
leverage or influence view when defined
uncertainty_requirements: state metric interval or resampling unit when an interval is shown
adversarial_checks: residual pattern by group, time, or coordinate
conclusion sensitivity to influential points without deleting them
accessibility_checks: identity and fitted lines differ by style
points remain legible in grayscale
recipes.minimum_falsification_view: Residual-versus-fitted view stratified by the most plausible hidden regime.

recipes.decision_question: Are two methods sufficiently close to be interchangeable within a predeclared tolerance?
admissible_claims: bias and limits of agreement for the named design
proportional or heteroscedastic disagreement when tested
prohibited_substitutions: high CCC as proof of interchangeability
preconditions: difference direction is fixed
repeated-reader or repeated-measure structure is modeled
acceptable difference is external to the observed agreement
uncertainty_requirements: state interval method for bias and each limit of agreement
adversarial_checks: swap method order and confirm sign contract
inspect difference variance across measurement magnitude
accessibility_checks: bias, limits, and acceptance limits use redundant line styles
paired IDs remain traceable
recipes.minimum_falsification_view: Difference-versus-mean view with the external acceptance limits shown separately from estimated limits of agreement.

recipes.decision_question: Do predicted probabilities match observed frequencies across a held-out evaluation set?
admissible_claims: calibration pattern under the declared binning
Brier score under the named evaluation design
preconditions: calibration fitting and final evaluation are separated
binning and empty-bin rules are fixed
uncertainty_requirements: state bin interval or resampling method
adversarial_checks: repeat with reasonable bin counts or adaptive bins
check low-count and subgroup bins
accessibility_checks: identity and model curves use redundant styles
bin count remains readable without color
recipes.minimum_falsification_view: Reliability curve with per-bin sample counts under at least one alternative defensible binning rule.

recipes.decision_question: What uncertainty surrounds each estimate, and what exact interval is displayed?
admissible_claims: estimate and named interval
comparison conditional on the interval design
prohibited_substitutions: SD, SE, CI, PI, and HDI as interchangeable
non-overlap as an automatic significance test
preconditions: center and interval method are identified
repetition or posterior unit is identified
minimum_views: sample or posterior count in caption
uncertainty_requirements: center, interval type, level, method, and multiplicity are explicit
adversarial_checks: show the full scientifically meaningful scale
check simultaneous versus pointwise interval claims
accessibility_checks: interval endpoints remain visible in grayscale
groups have direct or redundant labels
recipes.minimum_falsification_view: Point-interval view on the full decision-relevant scale with the null or requirement boundary visible.

recipes.decision_question: What is the observation-level distribution and the uncertainty around the effect estimate?
admissible_claims: distribution shape at the available sample size
paired or unpaired effect estimate with interval
preconditions: observation and replicate units are distinguished
pairing is preserved
uncertainty_requirements: state effect estimand and interval method
adversarial_checks: compare conclusions with ECDF or raw points
check sensitivity to bandwidth when density is shown
accessibility_checks: raw observations remain visible
group identity does not rely on color alone
recipes.minimum_falsification_view: Raw paired differences or ECDF that can reveal a mean effect driven by a small subset.

recipes.decision_question: How do ranking, precision-recall, and threshold-dependent utility behave on held-out data?
admissible_claims: ROC and PR behavior on the named split
threshold trade-off
net benefit only under an explicit utility model
preconditions: threshold selection is separated from final evaluation
positive class and prevalence are explicit
uncertainty_requirements: preserve fold, bootstrap, site, or subject resampling unit
adversarial_checks: inspect subgroup and site curves
compare the claimed operating point with nearby thresholds
accessibility_checks: methods use line style or symbols in addition to color
prevalence baseline is labeled
recipes.minimum_falsification_view: Precision-recall curve with the prevalence baseline and the proposed operating point on untouched evaluation data.

recipes.decision_question: How does event-free probability or cumulative incidence change under the declared censoring design?
admissible_claims: KM survival under non-informative censoring assumptions
cumulative incidence under an explicit competing-risk design
hazard ratio with checked model assumptions
prohibited_substitutions: one minus KM as competing-risk incidence
log-rank P value as effect magnitude
preconditions: time origin, event, censoring, and risk-set entry are defined
competing-risk status is declared
uncertainty_requirements: state interval method and model or resampling assumptions
adversarial_checks: verify risk-table counts by hand at selected times
inspect proportional-hazards or time-varying effects when a Cox model is used
accessibility_checks: groups use line styles and direct labels
censoring marks remain distinct
recipes.minimum_falsification_view: Curve plus risk table and censoring marks under the correctly coded event definition.

recipes.decision_question: Which parameters or components drive the outcome under a design that permits that attribution?
admissible_claims: global sensitivity under declared input distributions
paired ablation effect under aligned seeds, folds, and test data
prohibited_substitutions: independent Sobol indices for correlated inputs without qualification
preconditions: parameter distributions and dependence are declared
ablation configurations share the same seeds, folds, and evaluation set
minimum_views: S1 and ST with intervals or paired ablation deltas
uncertainty_requirements: state bootstrap or repeated-design interval and resampling unit
fail_closed_conditions: seed or fold sets do not align
adversarial_checks: vary defensible parameter ranges
show whether the component ranking changes across seeds or folds
accessibility_checks: S1 and ST or configurations use redundant symbols
zero and full-model reference lines are labeled
recipes.minimum_falsification_view: Paired delta or total-order view that can expose a claimed driver disappearing under aligned repetitions.

recipes.decision_question: What high-dimensional pattern remains under declared transformation, missingness, ordering, and clustering choices?
admissible_claims: pattern under the named transformation and order
cluster structure conditional on distance and linkage
prohibited_substitutions: a dendrogram as the unique natural grouping
preconditions: transform, scaling, missing-value code, distance, linkage, filtering, and order are recorded
minimum_views: color scale with unit or transformation
uncertainty_requirements: state stability or sensitivity method when clusters support a claim
adversarial_checks: compare input order with clustered order
repeat under at least one defensible scaling or distance choice
accessibility_checks: perceptually appropriate non-rainbow palette
missing values use a distinct non-data color
recipes.minimum_falsification_view: Static heatmap under the original order and one declared alternative transform or distance.

recipes.decision_question: What entities and scoped relationships form the network, and which visual channels encode actual fields?
admissible_claims: declared topology and edge attributes
network metrics computed under the named filtering rule
prohibited_substitutions: predicted or correlated edges as causality
preconditions: each visual channel maps to one declared field
filtering, multi-edge, isolated-node, layout algorithm, and seed rules are recorded
minimum_views: table or index for dense labels
uncertainty_requirements: show edge confidence or evidence class when edges are inferred
fail_closed_conditions: layout seed absent for stochastic layout
adversarial_checks: repeat one alternative defensible layout
show isolated or filtered counts
check that topology claims do not rely on geometry
accessibility_checks: node and edge classes use shape or line style in addition to color
labels or IDs remain keyboard-searchable in an interactive companion
recipes.minimum_falsification_view: Same filtered network under an alternative layout with edge semantics and isolated-node count held visible.

recipes.decision_question: How do scalar or vector fields and model-reference differences vary across shared coordinates, time, and scales?
admissible_claims: spatial or temporal pattern under the declared grid and interpolation
model-reference difference under a shared scale
scoped conservation or boundary residual
preconditions: coordinate orientation, aspect ratio, grid, interpolation, boundaries, units, and shared scale are fixed
reference and model are aligned in space and time
minimum_views: slice or profile for three-dimensional claims
uncertainty_requirements: show ensemble spread, interval, or explicitly state that uncertainty was not estimated
adversarial_checks: inspect conservation or boundary residual
compare with no interpolation or an alternative defensible interpolation
verify vector direction on an analytic field
accessibility_checks: perceptually appropriate sequential, diverging, or cyclic palette
difference sign is readable without red-green coding
recipes.minimum_falsification_view: Reference-model-difference triptych with shared coordinates and scale plus a conservation or boundary-residual view.
